notes.title: EggTime 2 - Halloween special !
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32697026/1bcf01f3d098887eeafba5202d09e40173e7ab67.png[/img]

Hello VR players !

Enjoy new free content for the game.
Make your Halloween even more special, there is a new game mode, where you have to defend your chickens against army of bad ghosts.

There are also two new achievements waiting just for you !

notes.title: EggTime 2 is here
notes.notes:
Yay, 

EggTime 2 was just released.
If you had fun playing the previous game and liked it you are in for a treat.

Have fun and enjoy our game !
